message: A developer portfolio site is a great starting point. To make sure we capture everything correctly, what visual style are you aiming for. For example, are you looking for something minimal and clean, bold and colorful, or something else entirely.

spec.description: A personal portfolio website for a software developer to showcase projects, skills, and professional experience.
features: Hero section with headline and call-to-action
Projects gallery with descriptions and links
open_questions: What visual style or design direction do you prefer?
Do you have any technology preferences?
Should the site include a blog or writing section?
Are there any accessibility or performance constraints?

quick_replies: Clean and minimal, like a modern SaaS site
